sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games, holding a 2-point advantage over second-placed Stafford Town. Alsager are in poor form and bottom of the table with just 4 points, having won only once all season, making this a winnable fixture for Sandbach to maintain their position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a direct title-race clash at 15:00 on Saturday, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points in fourth, face Wednesfield Community at home in Saturday's early kick-off. Barnton host Shawbury United in a mid-table encounter, while high-flying Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir looking to maintain their excellent run. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half clash, Telford Town face Cheadle Heath Nomads in a struggle at the lower end, and Widnes Town (pointless) travel to Brereton Social in the division's most lopsided matchup. Crewe host Allscott Heath at home as both search for consistency. On Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social entertain Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture at 19:45.
